about_the_game:
Leap Galaxy is a 2D platformer with a minimalistic aesthetic and gameplay that puts speed and flow first. Take advantage of momentum and master the recoil of your shots to reach insane speeds and beat each level as fast as possible!

In this demo you can experience the fast-paced gameplay of Leap Galaxy across a small selection of levels in every world, up to World 3, offering a taste of the game's diverse movement styles. The demo also includes time trials with online leaderboards as well as a limited selection playeable characters and color palettes to choose.

Demo feature list

  • A small selection of levels from the first 3 worlds, with new movement ways in each one.

  • A time trial for every world, consisting of completing all levels in a world consecutively.

  • Online leaderboards for every time trial.

  • Character and palette selection.

  • Available in English only.

The full game will feature many more levels and worlds, new characters and palettes to unlock, a shop system, secret levels and more!
